integrity: The finite integer checker is not offered as proof of an infinite asymptotic. The full proof invokes the classical Selberg–Delange theorem and establishes arithmetic local factors and coefficient nonvanishing. Prior published density is not claimed anew.
limitations: Only fixed modulus 3; coefficient given as absolutely convergent complex Euler product, not certified numerically; no uniform growing-modulus estimate; the leading density is already known. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: A sharp oscillating secondary residue bias for the Erdős prime-power quotient sum
